title: Codebase for: Assessing the Added Value of Earth Observations for Multi-Model Kilometre-Scale Hydrological Modelling Across Contrasting Basins
description:
Python code to reproduce the figures and tables of the manuscript Assessing the Added Value of Earth Observations for Multi-Model Kilometre-Scale Hydrological Modelling Across Contrasting Basins (Water Resources Research, 2025WR042446). The study evaluates up to five hydrological and land-surface models (CLM, JULES, mHM, PCR-GLOBWB and TETIS) at about 1 km in the Po, Rhine and Tugela basins, driven by conventional or EO-based (HYPER-P) precipitation and calibrated against EO soil moisture, evapotranspiration and snow cover, alone or together with discharge.

The scripts start from the gauge-level daily KGE scores archived separately on Zenodo; download_data.py retrieves them and run_all.py regenerates all outputs.
